Adding a required SamplingConfig SamplingStrategy field directly breaks the struct literal in newJaegerReceiver() since Go requires all fields in a struct literal to be explicitly set or the new field must have a zero value that is acceptable. The factory chain (NewFactory -> createTracesReceiver -> newJaegerReceiver) propagates the break: if newJaegerReceiver needs a SamplingConfig parameter, createTracesReceiver must extract it from Config, and Config must define it. Cross-repo, both Jaeger v2 (jaegertracing/jaeger) and Tempo (grafana/tempo) import and register the jaegerreceiver factory. They would need to update their go.mod dependencies and ensure their YAML configs or programmatic configs supply the new SamplingConfig field.
